issues.reviewReason: This is a complaint about QA fix verification methodology — fix screenshots were showing wrong pages. The issue raised is valid: fix shots need to show the ACTUAL fixed screen, not the dashboard or an unrelated page. The root cause is that the recapture flow navigates to /dashboard first for auth, then sometimes fails to reach the target route. Fix already applied (i-20260703 process): verification protocol updated to read ALL screenshots + critically confirm the recaptured PNG shows the correct screen. However owner wants a PERMANENT guardrail — requesting a way to auto-validate that fix screenshot matches the issue's route. This needs product discussion: should I add a route-hash check to qa.mjs resolve, or is the current manual review process sufficient?

fix.description: Root cause: 269 tmp/ binary files (15+ MB: coach portraits, fix screenshots, downloaded issue images) were committed to the public qa-issues repo despite tmp/ being in .gitignore. GitHub Pages artifact size caused 'syncing_files -> Deployment failed, try again later' on every push. Fix: git rm -r --cached tmp/ to untrack all tmp/ blobs. Future pushes to tmp/ are now correctly ignored. Commit b8190f6.

judge.note: Root cause identified and fixed: Pages deploy was failing because 15+ MB of tmp/ binaries were tracked in the public repo. Untracking 269 files removes the bloat. Issue was structural/recurring, not transient. Fix is permanent.
